tips.text: Ignore the Perita order count; orders pay Tauron Strike resources, so kill enemies and break containers for Uriel's materials.
Once you have reached floor 21 for the week, re-enter at 21; repeating the full tower for parts is wasted time.
Pay 25 Maphica for a missing part instead of grinding Roathe for that one drop.
Run Descendia solo or premade; a squad wipe fails the floor and public squads ignore the floor mechanics.
Kill Roathe solo if you can; public squads delete him fast on any difficulty.
Check the weekly layout for an early Plunder floor; a loot room week pays Maphica fast, but most weeks have none.
Farm Uriel's materials alongside the Tektolyst artifact grind in Perita; they fall out as a side effect.
Pick the Perita boss you can kill inside 30 minutes; Vanguard is fastest with single-target damage and miserable without it.
The blueprint half is one of the easier frame farms; the materials swing from two runs to three weeks depending on loot frame and boosters.
